name: Schwimmbad-Camping Hall
beschreibung: The Schwimmbad-Camping Hall is located in the town of Hall in Tirol in Österreich. The campsite is situated in natural surroundings with a view of the Tiroler Berge. The surroundings offer access to hiking trails and are close to ski areas. The facilities include pitches, sanitary facilities, and a swimming pool. Guests can expect a quiet atmosphere for relaxation and outdoor activities. The location also allows excursions to sights in Hall and the region.
